This value set includes codes based on the following rules:

  • Include these codes as defined in http://loinc.org version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server)
    CodeDisplay
    LA29518-0He, him, his
    LA29519-8She, her, hers
    LA29520-6They, them, theirs (non-binary)
    LA29521-4Ze, hir, hirs (non-binary)
    LA29523-0Ze, zir, zirs (non-binary)
  • Include these codes as defined in http://ahip.org/demographics/CodeSystem/ahip-demo-additional-nullFlavor version 📦0.1.0
    CodeDisplayDefinition
    UMNUse my nameThis code is to represent explicitly that the patient do not want a pronoun to be used but instead use their name.
    CNTRI choose not to respond at this timeThis code is to represent explicitly that the patient has chosen not to respond to this question at this time.
  • Include these codes as defined in http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-NullFlavor version 📍4.0.0
    CodeDisplayDefinition
    ASKUI don't knowInformation was sought but not found (e.g., patient was asked but didn't know)

description: Used as the answer options for the preferred pronouns question in the SOGI and Relationship Status Section, capturing the pronouns a patient uses to identify themselves. Based on LOINC
